global.tagline: Where <u>paws</u>, <u>hands</u> and hearts tell their <u>story</u> in a single image.
global.about-text: I'm Laura de los Laureles, a photographer and animal lover. I'm thrilled at the possibility of meeting your multispecies family! When you decide to have a photo session with those you love the most, you're investing in an unforgettable life experience. I want to be part of that experience with you—capturing the most authentic, sweet, and joyful bond in images that you'll treasure forever. You're not just getting photography sessions, but a complete experience of joy and comfort in a space entirely designed for beloved animals. My goal is for you and your furry friend to feel comfortable and relaxed during the session, so we can capture heartwarming and fun moments that will last—and light up your life every time you see the images on your phone, decorating your home, on your computer, or anywhere you want to feel close to your beloved companion.

packages_description.desc_chihuahua: An intimate studio session designed so your companion feels at ease while we capture their essence with controlled light.
packages_description.desc_galgo: Ideal if you want more photo variety in a calm space thoughtfully set up for animals.
packages_description.desc_akita: The most complete studio experience: extra time to explore poses, bonds, and details at an unhurried pace.
packages_description.desc_pug: An outdoor session at a special location, perfect for natural portraits and spontaneous moments.
packages_description.desc_mestizo: Two outdoor locations to explore different settings and take home a more varied gallery.
packages_description.desc_dogo: The most complete outdoor option: more photos, more time, and two locations for a memorable session.
packages_description.desc_gift_card: Gift an unforgettable photography experience. The gift card can be used for the package you choose together.

global.brand_message: Do you have a brand that loves animals as much as I do? Let’s create authentic and professional visual content together that connects with your audience.
